Aisha Khan: Thanks everyone — quick follow-up from today's all‑hands re: sales pipeline & partnerships. I'll leave this thread open for questions for the next 30m.
Marco Sanchez: Quick Q — what is our current pipeline velocity and are we prioritizing enterprise or mid‑market this quarter?
Aisha Khan: Short answer: both. We're tracking a healthy qualified pipeline and leaning into mid‑market this quarter to improve velocity while keeping enterprise deals with dedicated AEs. Focus is on scalable motion + a couple of strategic enterprise closes.
Devon (sales_ops): How are we aligning Dedicated capacity (reserved GPU pools) with partner co‑sell? e.g., partner‑led deals need predictable capacity/burst?
Lina — Partnerships: Yes — top priorities:
```
1) Strategic partners: co-sell + dedicated capacity + joint SLAs
2) ISV integrations: marketplace listing + technical enablement
3) Channel resellers: volume discounts + enablement packs
```
We're finalizing pricing tiers and a partner SLA draft.
Harper (CTO): Product note — we carved out Q3 roadmap slot for partner analytics and per-partner usage dashboards. Goal: expose usage, cost allocation, and a simple quota sync API. ETA: end of Q3 (tentative).
Marco Sanchez: Can we get a 1‑pager for sales that summarizes these partner changes and who to engage per tier?
Lina — Partnerships: Yes — here's the quick link to the draft (internal): https://redwood.internal/docs/partnerships/partner-rollout — I'll post a short exec summary + FAQ by EOD.
Devon (sales_ops): Who owns enablement content? I can spin up a playbook if someone shares slides/assets.
Lina — Partnerships: Assigning initial enablement to Devon and Maia. @Devon can you pick this up? I'll share the partner kit (tech brief, pricing, slide deck) by EOD.
Maia (CS Enablement): On it — I'll draft a playbook and two role-based cheat sheets (AE + SE). Will ping when ready.
Aisha Khan: Thanks — small ask for GTM leads: post any outstanding blockers in this thread or DM me by EOD so we can action at tomorrow's GTM sync. Recording of the all-hands is here: https://meetings.redwood/rec/1769458800
allhands-bot: Recording posted: https://meetings.redwood/rec/1769458800
Devon (sales_ops): :thumbsup: I'll compile blockers and DM Aisha.
Lina — Partnerships: Also opening a short ticket in the partner backlog for pricing tiers — will tag relevant owners.
Aisha Khan: Great — appreciate the quick turn. If anyone needs a hand drafting customer‑facing language, flag it here and we'll pair with comms.
